{{Quote|I need a Nolarian 6000 drill immediately.''"<br />"''Don't have one. There's a shortage. And the way the mining safety committee has been watching us, there will be for a good while.|Doctor Lundi and the machinery dealer|<ref name="TF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''machinery dealer''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nolar]]<ref name="TF" /> in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> When [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Murk Lundi]] attempted to purchase a [[Nolarian 6000 drill]] from him, the dealer informed him that he did not have any due to a shortage. When Lundi continued to insist on it, the dealer repeated that he did not know when he would get more in because of how closely the [[mining safety committee]] was watching the situation. Enraged, the Quermian yelled at the dealer, calling him a "pathetic weakling" and causing the dealer to freeze and stare at the doctor as he left the shop.<ref name="TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The machinery dealer was mentioned in the [[2002]] young readers novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TF" />
